svg.title: SkillGuard-Lite realistic synthetic corpus, two fresh executions on the same sixteen skills
svg.text: 16 synthetic skills in 8 matched pairs. Two fresh runs on the same corpus, not 32 independent skills.
B = BENIGN M = MALICIOUS E = ERROR ! = incomplete * = malicious intent, no observed violation
Structured verdicts: SkillGuard alone correct on 1/16 skills in run 1, 1/16 in run 2. Reverse: 0, 0.
Different misses: run 1 case-10 contradicts its own reason; run 2 case-07 overlooks the supplied explicit-address task.
Stable completed verdicts: text 14/16 skills, SkillGuard 16/16 skills. No pooled classification score.
GPT-6 Luna via API, reasoning none, temperature 0. Six fixed payment tasks. Fuji fork block 59,275,449.
Text review is an API proxy, not the ChatGPT app. Synthetic results and two repetitions do not establish general superiority.
Author labels describe intent. Observed violations require local send evidence. Trusted-contact swaps remain outside the oracle.
Local fork transfers only. Method resources include attempted rows. Tokens are returned usage, not billing. Unequal compute budgets.
